title: The Figure-Eight Lap
summary: On Wednesday, February 11, 2015, while VDOT snowplows begin clearing the blizzard drifts outside Star City General Hospital in Roanoke, Jordan shares a soft cardiac breakfast with Zoë and completes his mandatory post-CABG Figure-Eight physical therapy lap around the sixth-floor CVICU pods without a single trace of chest pain.

scenes.title: Soft Cardiac Breakfast and the Figure-Eight Lap
